# JJ Fund

> JJ Fund is an AI-native venture platform connecting Western startups with Asia: part fund, part advisory, part build partner. It helps founders raise capital, establish India Global Capability Centres (GCCs) and scale across Asia, and gives VCs and family offices access to vetted AI and SaaS opportunities. Regulated work (accounting, tax, legal, compliance) is delivered through a vetted professional partner network.

## Led by
- Jignesh P Jain, Mumbai. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jignesh1409/
